text.description_html:
AHI SIG728-630, Extra Large Door Stop & Holder

AHI's SIG728-630 Satin Stainless Steel Door Stop is designed to sit on the floor and hold a door in the open position or stop the door from hitting a wall. It has black rubber on the bottom to protect the floor from scratches. This extra large 3-5/8" diameter door holder is made from 2-1/2 pounds of solid stainless steel with a beautiful satin finish.

Specifications for the AHI SIG728-630 Extra Large Door Stop Holder:

  • Material: 304 Stainless Steel
  • Finish: Satin Stainless Steel
  • Rubber Color: Black
  • Bumper Diameter: 3-5/8" (92 mm)
  • Base Diameter: 3-3/16" (81 mm)
  • Total Height: 1-1/4" (33 mm)
  • Weight: 2-1/2 Lbs.
  • AHI SIG728 Dimensions (PDF)

Sold Individually
